episode.episode_title: The Git history you didn't mean to share
episode.episode_description: Z.ai's ZCode agent has been caught uploading sensitive local repository data to the cloud. We look at the privacy implications for developers and why 'convenience' features are often a security liability.
episode.selection_reason: The lead verified story from today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.

short.title: ZCode agent caught oversharing local Git history
short.description:
This incident highlights the significant privacy risks when AI coding tools are granted broad access to local environments, potentially exposing internal secrets or deleted API keys without the user's explicit intent.

Read today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief: https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/daily-brief/
short.script: ZCode agent caught oversharing local Git history. Security researcher ferstar found that Z.ai’s ZCode agent automatically uploaded full local repository snapshots, including sensitive .git history. Read the Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
